core_obligations: Show the extension is semi-local and pass to the integral closure, choosing a finite subalgebra which agrees with the extension away from the finitely many maximal ideals (proof lines 31204-31210).

Compare the two sides of the displayed inequality through the indices of the finite subalgebra in the extension, and identify the equality case with the extension being finite by the ideal argument given at the end (proof lines 31210-31232).
proof_roadmap: Reduce to a finite subalgebra of the integral closure (proof lines 31204-31210).
Compare the order sums and read off the equality case (proof lines 31210-31233).
difficulty_reason: The lemma states that a finite type extension of a one-dimensional local Noetherian domain with finite fraction field extension is semi-local, and bounds the order of an element times the degree by a sum of local orders weighted by residue field degrees, with equality exactly when the extension is finite (statement lines 31180-31202). The proof does not compute the orders directly: it passes to a finite subalgebra of the integral closure agreeing with the extension away from the maximal ideals, compares the two sides through the indices of that subalgebra, and detects finiteness by exhibiting an ideal of denominators which lies in no maximal ideal (proof lines 31204-31233). The comparison through the finite subalgebra is the step carrying the estimate. H2.
